data.body: DEFENSE_RECORD: {"finding_id": "f-k1l2m3n4", "defense_text": "Not a shell injection vector. The value of DSO_LIST_JSON is stdout from 'dso ticket list' \u2014 a controlled binary in the same repo that emits JSON. The bash assignment 'DSO_LIST_JSON=\"$list_output\" python3 -c ...' uses double-quoting which prevents bash word-splitting/glob-expansion regardless of value content. The Python side uses json.loads(os.environ.get(...)) which handles any UTF-8 byte sequence as a JSON payload (well-formed or not); malformed JSON falls through to the bare 'except Exception' on line 357 and the consolidation lookup is silently skipped. The dso CLI does not run user-controlled string interpolation into its JSON output. Risk: low.", "severity_history": [{"cycle": 1, "severity": "critical"}]}
